plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Per-repo project memory: auto-injects PROJECT_MEMORY.md into context each session and captures durable facts with /project-memory:memo, so you never re-explain a project.

plugins.name: genjutsu-video
plugins.description: Recreate reference-video performance with supplied characters, clothing and environments, then inspect fine details and timing.

plugins.name: casino-voice-cloner
plugins.description: Isolate and level original speech, convert it to an authorized target voice and preserve the video timeline.

plugins.name: casino-continuity-inspector
plugins.description: Independently check finished faces, clothes, environments, source words and audiovisual timing with timestamped repair findings.

plugins.name: code-to-lottie
plugins.description: Convert tagged SVG + CSS-keyframe animations to true-vector Lottie JSON (bodymovin) with three-stage verification: keyframe-timing diff, geometry round-trip, and a >=99% browser pixel-diff against the source.

plugins.name: source-timeline-mapper
plugins.description: Prepare exact source-to-output video/audio maps, genuine handles and verified clip boundaries with a second artifact-based check.

plugins.name: casino-media-integrator
plugins.description: Stage approved video and audio for the casino, verify authoritative results and voice scheduling, then independently recheck the final candidate.

plugins.name: casino-media-coordinator
plugins.description: Coordinate reference-video, voice, timeline, review and casino integration workers using current project evidence and independent rechecks.
